## Ruled-out approaches
- Do not increase Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours; it concealed stuck jobs and did not fix duplicate reconciliation runs.
- Never seed or write to frozen `billing_v1`; active schema is `billing_v3`.
- Defer the Tenacity/type-annotation refactor until next sprint.
- Keep the shared embedding client and transactional bulk upsert; do not create clients per rebuild or use one transaction per vector.
- Do not add another UTF-8 writer or depend on platform-default encoding.
- Do not modify `ledgerly/customer_export/` without posting the proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and obtaining `@mina`’s approval.
- Run security scans through `./tools/scan-ledgerly.sh`, not Bandit directly.

## Recent work
- Payroll March 2025 batch was created/submitted: `batch-20250328-1842`, 248 payments, total `$986,442.17`. Remaining in order: obtain `treasury.ops` approval for control total `986442.17`; submit for `2025-03-28` with request ID `run-20250328-payroll`; send `payroll-paid-v4` notification with request ID `notify-20250328-payroll`.
- Billing fixes added Decimal-safe discount conversion and timezone-aware ledger timestamps. Billing tests passed (34), full suite passed (96), and `mypy ledgerly/billing` passed.
- Invoice test setup was refactored with a rollback `db_session` fixture, `make_invoice`/`organization_factory` fixtures, and module-scoped customer batching. Targeted invoice, customer, subscription, and report tests passed.
- Frozen `clock` fixture was added for subscription renewal tests; 52 subscription tests passed, 3 skipped.
- An invoice credit/refund test still fails: expected total `87.50`, service returns `90.00`. The likely cause is `CreditMemo.amount` being applied before `refund_total` is deducted in `apply_credit`; investigate and fix next.
- A paused annotation change modified invoice/ledger signatures and fixed `build_invoice_lines` by wrapping its generator with `list(...)`; recheck with mypy/tests.
- Refund double-counting investigation in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py` has not begun.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Avoided constructing a separate embedding client per document/rebuild; the shared `EmbeddingClient` is injected into `SearchIndexRebuilder`.
- Avoided one transaction per vector; `bulk_upsert()` uses one transaction to prevent duplicate/inefficient upserts.
- Avoided platform-default CSV encoding; `write_rows()` now explicitly uses UTF-8.
- Did not add a second UTF-8 writer; `ledgerly/io/text_writer.py` already implements the required behavior.
- Do not modify anything under `ledgerly/customer_export/` without posting the proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and receiving approval from `@mina`.
- Do not run Bandit directly; use `./tools/scan-ledgerly.sh` to preserve custom exclusions and baseline comparison.
